test: H01 pairwise meetings do not establish a joint occasion
note: Independent expected sets distinguish three pairwise meetings from one joint occasion. The ordinary incidence API is explicitly an alias, not independent benchmark evidence.

test: H02 repeated groups preserve occasion-specific roles
note: Separate event IDs preserve the known cook at each occasion; downstream agent recall is deferred.
A mentioned person has unknown participation, never inferred absence.

test: H04 a narrator account does not become a group feeling
note: Only the narrator receives an attributed feeling record; whether a model refrains from generalizing it is deferred.

test: H05 checked links connect supplied occasion interpretations
note: The checked relation connects two supplied, explicitly occasion-linked accounts. Removing the relation omits I2 from selected-seed traversal but reports omittedFromSelectedView and incomplete coverage. Direct occasion lookup already knows I2 is relevant; no lexical discovery or retrieval-benefit claim is established.

test: H06 different questions reject checked revisit
note: Different local question IDs reject checked reinterpretation traversal.

test: H07 equal labels do not equate local question IDs
note: Equal question labels do not override different question IDs.
Ambiguous occasion candidates remain unresolved and cannot enter the confirmed traversal.

test: H09 traversal caps and encountered cycles are distinguished
note: Both a cycle reached inside the depth cap and a cycle hidden behind the cap terminate without duplicate accounts; only the reached cycle is identified.

test: H10 unavailable event does not resurrect its narrative
note: An unavailable occasion yields no occasion narrative while separately eligible reflection sources remain accessible. This tests source eligibility, not physical erasure of sidecars.

test: H11 retrieval frequency creates no retirement policy
note: The operation reads no usage or ledger decay field and introduces no rarity-based deletion.

test: H12 querying subgroups does not create pairwise events
note: Pair queries return co-participation at the single existing occasion and do not mutate or generate events.

test: H13 shared attendance does not imply simultaneous presence
note: Non-overlapping attendance intervals do not support simultaneous presence.

test: H14 changed revisions and unresolved people suppress old answers
note: Changed supplied source revision or unresolved participant identity prevents the previous unqualified match. Revision production itself is a caller obligation.

test: H15 capped input never claims exhaustive coverage
note: A proxy counts exactly 20 indexed input reads from 1000 records; incomplete coverage remains explicit.

test: H16 interpretation authorship does not imply attendance
note: An attributed interpretation by Dana has a matching boundary without adding Dana to participation. Automatic author/attendance extraction remains untested.
